summary: Route file-watch events and coverage changes only to intersecting input leases

schema.detail: The performance endpoint adds cumulative file_watch_work counters for events, event and coverage deliveries, scoped versus global notifications, and current physical roots, logical leases, coverage generations and FSEvents streams.

rules.detail: Root-indexed routing applies lexical and referent input relevance before borrowing an event to selected callbacks. Coverage replacement and directory-loss generations are scoped to intersecting roots. File-gate changes enqueue only their dependent mission runs; launch-admission or other global readers and genuine lost-path rescans retain the common-loop notification. Cached file observations retain their external-input dependency independently of the narrower actual-state dependency, so settled mission gates remain subscribed to filesystem changes.

compatibility.detail: Any matching path, ancestor renames and removals, symlink referents, case-insensitive APFS directory aliases, and backend-error rescans remain observable. Unrelated sibling activity and read events do not notify reconciliation.

recovery.detail: The pinned notify patch preserves one shared macOS FSEvents stream and resumes reconfigured streams from the last fully delivered journal event ID without purging history. Reconfiguration gaps replay unrelated-root events rather than broadcasting rescans or adding one thread per root. True loss/drop/wrap and error events retain all-root recovery; HistoryDone alone is a replay barrier, not loss. Failed or removed physical coverage releases its generation entry.
